workflow: A streaming fallback reuses one mutable buffer for successive chunks while output transmission may still reference an earlier chunk.
Flow control is awaited before enqueueing the current chunk, so the prior transmission is not completed before the buffer is reused.
A worker overwrites the buffer for the next read while another execution context reads it to transmit the previous chunk.
The unsynchronized accesses form a data race, which instrumentation reports as a process failure instead of completing the transfer.
summary: Reused streaming buffer is concurrently read and overwritten
